docs.text:
Assalam-o-Alaikum! 🇵🇰

I'm a passionate Data Scientist at Codanics — and guess what? I'm also the founder! 🚀

docs.title: 👨‍💻 My Journey
docs.text: From the bustling streets of Pakistan to the world of data, I've been on a mission to turn numbers into stories. Whether it's crunching datasets or building machine learning models, I love adding a little Pakistani tarka to every project!

docs.title: 🏆 What I Do
docs.text:
• 📊 Data Analysis with a desi twist
  • 🤖 Machine Learning & AI
  • 🧠 Solving real-world problems
  • 💡 Innovating at Codanics

docs.title: 🌶️ My Tarka
docs.text: I believe in mixing creativity, hard work, and a dash of chai ☕ to make data science fun and impactful. If you're looking for someone who brings energy, ideas, and a bit of Pakistani spice to the table, you're in the right place!

docs.title: 📫 Let's Connect!
docs.text: Feel free to reach out — let's make data delicious together! 😄
